connectionTypes.sourceNote: SOURCED (secondary) — electricbill.in Manipur MSPDCL tariff listing, LT Non-Domestic/Commercial category. Numbers are internally consistent with the expected cross-subsidy pattern (commercial > residential > agriculture) but could not be cross-checked against a primary JERC/MSPDCL tariff order PDF — the only official tariff PDF link found (mspdcl.in) returned HTTP 404 at time of research, and no working replacement was located. Pending primary-source verification.

SOURCED (secondary) — electricbill.in Manipur MSPDCL tariff listing, 'Cottage & Small Industry' LT category (flat ₹6.15/unit, not slabbed), chosen as the representative small/LT industrial tier over the site's 'Medium Industry' (₹8.80/unit) and 'Large Industry' (₹9.85/unit) categories, which are more likely HT. Not cross-checked against a primary JERC/MSPDCL tariff order — the official mspdcl.in tariff PDF link returned HTTP 404 at time of research. Pending primary-source verification.

SOURCED (secondary) — electricbill.in Manipur MSPDCL tariff listing, 'LT Irrigation & Agriculture' category (flat ₹4.91/unit, not slabbed). Rate is below both the residential slab-2 and slab-3 rates and below all commercial/industrial rates, broadly consistent with expected agricultural cross-subsidy, but not cross-checked against a primary JERC/MSPDCL tariff order — the official mspdcl.in tariff PDF link returned HTTP 404 at time of research. Pending primary-source verification.
